infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Sentinel Mobile uses the camera to capture intruder photos upon unauthorized unlock attempts and scan 2FA QR codes.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Sentinel Mobile uses your GPS location to share your real-time coordinates with emergency contacts during SOS distress.
infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Sentinel Mobile uses Face ID to securely unlock your encrypted vault.
infoPlist.NSMotionUsageDescription: Sentinel Mobile monitors motion to trigger anti-theft tripwire alarms and shake-to-SOS.
